port_extensions._note: Port-only additions (Opus 5.5 DRAFT for gap F of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md). The historical schema saea-stage3-rollout-analysis-recipe-v1 has no slot for a cross-run comparison reference, a parity band, a cross-run bar or a twin admissibility rule, so they live here. Every existing loader ignores this object: scripts/checks/flight_registration_check.py reads only read_run_id / run_ids.read, schema and the system-text binding keys (family_id, context_learning_registration, system_panel_registration, pilot_registration, measurement_profile), and scripts/analysis/slurp_l338_column_read.py reads no recipe key (its ids, arms, floors and seed come from scripts/flights/nx/l338_family.py). Every top-level key outside this object keeps the historical recipe's key and scoring definition; only the ids, the authority, the registration time, the stage notes and the next-step sentence differ. DRAFT: registers a reading rule, authorises nothing.

comparison_reference.role: the recipe's pinned point reference (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md Decision 1). Reported beside the band; the port is never read against this point alone.
comparison_reference.system: the 268-B Thinking lock arm: the L338 delivering arm lock is the 268-B lock form, its requests the lock's byte for byte (scripts/flights/nx/l338_family.py module docstring; docs/results/2026-10-29-fold-b-comparison-baseline-read.md headline)

cross_run_bar.improvement_rule: IMPROVEMENT-ADMISSIBLE when, in one admissible port run (registered_comparisons[0]), an arm's official pooled SLU-F1 is at or above 75.25 (the band top 72.75 + 2.5 pp) AND its paired SLU delta against the port's own lock arm has a CI95 lower bound above zero (this recipe's primary interval) AND the twin arm aa agrees (aa inside the band). Otherwise no cross-run improvement statement is made; the within-run words stand on their own.
cross_run_bar.refused: cross-flight-no-replicate: a run without the twin arm supports no cross-run statement (instrument rule 4; scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py cross-flight-no-replicate)
cross_run_bar.rule_3_note: the instrument's rule 3 admits a cross-flight arm only when its delta's CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the delta exceeds the in-chain replicate's own measured offset plus that offset's half-width; 2.5 pp is the value of that bar at n = 1,080 as the floor check registers it, so a measured twin offset larger than the registered one raises the bar for that run
sources: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md:98 (Decision 4 revised: aa is the cross-run twin)

parity_band.basis: 8 lock-form readings of the same Thinking system on this roster (SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2, n = 1,080), Q4_K_M llama.cpp, development numbers; band = [min, max] over the 8 readings of each metric (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md section 1 Decision 1 table; collected in docs/results/2026-10-29-fold-b-comparison-baseline-read.md section 3)
parity_band.consequence: OUTSIDE-BAND on the port lock arm: S2 does not start; the declared deviations (design doc section 8, items 8.1-8.7) are read first, by arm and by contact node, and the owner decides whether the port is the comparison base (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md section 2).
parity_band.rule: PARITY when the arm's official pooled SLU-F1 lies in [71.61, 72.75] AND its intent accuracy lies in [84.91, 85.74], both inclusive, on the official scorer's two-decimal percent. Otherwise OUTSIDE-BAND, reported with the metric, the side (below / above) and the distance in pp. S0 PARITY needs lock and aa inside the band and the run admissible under registered_comparisons[0] (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md Decision 4 revised, :98).

registered_comparisons.admissibility_rule: the run is ADMISSIBLE as a cross-run comparison only when |SLU-F1(aa) - SLU-F1(lock)| <= 1.20 pp (the point delta of the two official column scorings); otherwise NOT-ADMISSIBLE
registered_comparisons.contrast: aa minus lock, paired per row, official pooled SLU-F1 and intent accuracy, this recipe's interval (10,000 draws, seed 20261018); reported beside the words exactly as the historical recipe does
registered_comparisons.on_not_admissible: no cross-run statement (parity, improvement over the band) is made from the run; the same-flight within-run words are unaffected because both sides of each within-run contrast share the run
registered_comparisons.registration_status: REGISTERED (part of the port cell and of the historical recipe's twin key)
registered_comparisons.role: the cross-run twin: the registered in-flight A/A (replicate_of lock: the lock's request byte for byte, seed 20260913, temperature 0); no lock-twin arm is registered, contacts stay 15 per row and every registered cap is unchanged
registered_comparisons.threshold_basis: the parity band width 72.75 - 71.61 = 1.14 pp, rounded up to 1.2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-fold-b-comparison-baseline-and-improvement-plan.md Decision 4 revised, :98)

within_run_bar.unchanged: identical to this recipe's primary, guard, word_rules and word_order (byte-identical to the historical recipe): arm minus lock, paired per row (one row = one utterance recording, so the utterance-cluster bootstrap is row-paired), CI95, 10,000 draws, seed 20261018, floors 1.49 pp SLU / 0.65 pp intent at n = 1,080 (design same-flight-node-column)

what_is_not_here: No margins block and no admission: nothing is locked here.

L1.HARM: SLU delta CI95 upper bound < -1.49 pp, or intent delta CI95 upper bound < -0.65 pp
L1.NOMINATED: SLU delta CI95 lower bound >= 1.49 pp AND intent delta CI95 upper bound >= -0.65 pp (no resolved intent loss)

L2.HARM: intent delta CI95 upper bound < -0.65 pp, or SLU delta CI95 upper bound < -1.49 pp
L2.NOMINATED: intent delta CI95 lower bound >= 0.65 pp AND SLU delta CI95 upper bound >= -1.49 pp (no resolved SLU loss)
